title: Minimum and Maximum Payout Amounts on Northloop Payments Plans
content:
The smallest and the largest amounts Northloop Payments pays out are fixed per payout plan.

- **Minimum payout amount** — the smallest available amount that is paid out; a smaller amount rolls to the next payout. Stated in USD.
- **Maximum per payout** — the largest amount sent in one scheduled payout; the excess rolls to the next payout. Stated in USD.

## Figures by plan

| Payout plan | Payments Starter | Payments Biweekly | Payments Weekly | Payments Daily | Payments Daily Plus | Payments Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum payout amount (USD) | 25.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Maximum per payout (USD) | 10000.00 | 50000.00 | 50000.00 | 100000.00 | 250000.00 | 2000000.00 |

## Points of reading

- The minimum payout amount is 25.00 USD on Payments Starter and 1.00 USD on every other plan.
- The maximum per payout rises with the plan, from 10000.00 USD on Payments Starter to 2000000.00 USD on Payments Enterprise; Payments Biweekly and Payments Weekly share the same 50000.00 USD figure.
- Hypothetical illustration: an available amount of 18.00 USD is below the Payments Starter minimum of 25.00 USD and rolls to the next payout under that plan, while it is not below the 1.00 USD minimum of Payments Weekly.
